last_review.summary: Reviewed all eight acceptance checks. HTML parsing, JavaScript syntax, seating counts, purchase persistence, ordinary CSV round-tripping, three multipage A2 PDF builds, and QR payload handling passed the checks I could run. The sandbox prevented Chromium from starting, so live browser, touch, download, network-panel, and phone-scan checks remain unverified.
issues: Criterion 1. Serve the working builder at index.html on disk and on a static host. The current index.html serves a landing page, and the builder runs at app.html.

Criterion 3. Recover malformed CSV records without discarding valid rows between them. Two unclosed quotes on separate lines swallowed a valid row and produced only one row error. The fallback parser also imported a field with junk after its closing quote. Report each malformed row at its original line number.

Criterion 4. Wrap long unbroken table names in CSV import messages and constrain the guest-view grid to the viewport. The report currently places user-supplied table names in an unconstrained grid track without a wrap rule.
Criterion 5. Configure a working PAYMENT_URL. The purchase button opens the placeholder Stripe URL.

Criterion 7. Size the QR quiet zone in modules. The fixed 6 mm white border provides fewer than four modules for low-density codes, where the surrounding poster background can interfere with scanning.
Criterion 8. Remove the out-of-plan landing page, notes, sample images, fontkit, and custom font assets. Use the allowed system and built-in PDF fonts with the existing PDF and QR libraries.
